categories.main_business_segments: Biwin Storage Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, packaging, testing, production, and sales of semiconductor memory products and advanced packaging and testing services. Its product portfolio includes embedded storage, PC storage, industrial and automotive-grade storage, enterprise-level storage, mobile storage, and advanced packaging services. The company serves diverse markets such as mobile smart terminals, PCs, industry terminals, data centers, smart automobiles, and mobile storage devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor storage technologies including NAND Flash and DRAM chips, with expertise in storage solution development, controller chip design, advanced wafer-level packaging, and storage chip testing equipment. It employs cutting-edge packaging technologies such as 16-layer stacked die, ultra-thin die, multi-chip heterogeneous integration, and wafer-level advanced packaging including Fanout Memory Stack (FOMS) and Computing Memory Chiplet (CMC) technologies. Biwin also develops proprietary firmware algorithms, LDPC error correction, and automated testing systems to ensure high performance, reliability, and low power consumption.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Biwin serves leading domestic and international customers across multiple sectors including smartphone manufacturers (e.g., OPPO, Xiaomi, Motorola), PC OEMs (e.g., Lenovo, HP, Acer), AI/AR smart glasses producers (e.g., Meta, Google), enterprise data centers, automotive manufacturers, and emerging AI edge devices. Its products are integrated into AI smartphones, AI PCs, smart wearables, industrial automation, smart cars, and mobile storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shenzhen and production facilities in Huizhou and other locations. It has established a global presence with subsidiaries and sales networks in North America, Latin America, India, Europe, Hong Kong, the United States, Brazil, and other regions. Its products are sold in over 39 countries and regions worldwide, supported by localized marketing and service teams.
categories.supply_chain_position: Biwin operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor storage supply chain. It procures NAND Flash and DRAM wafers and chips from leading global manufacturers and focuses on in-house design of controller chips, advanced packaging, testing, and module manufacturing. The company integrates storage solutions and advanced wafer-level packaging, providing comprehensive services from chip design to final product assembly and testing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in storage solutions, controller chip design, advanced wafer-level packaging, and storage chip testing equipment. It focuses on developing high-performance, low-power storage products for AI smartphones, AI PCs, smart wearables, and automotive applications. Biwin is advancing wafer-level advanced packaging technologies to enable storage-compute integration, aiming to overcome memory bandwidth and power consumption bottlenecks in the AI era. It also emphasizes expanding its product portfolio with innovations like Mini SSDs and high-capacity LPDDR5X memory.
categories.revenue_model: Biwin generates revenue primarily through the sales of semiconductor storage products including embedded storage modules, PC storage devices, industrial and automotive-grade storage, enterprise-level storage solutions, and mobile storage products. Additionally, it earns income from advanced packaging and testing services. The company employs a combination of direct sales to OEMs and brand-authorized sales through distributors and retail channels globally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Biwin is positioned as a leading domestic semiconductor storage and advanced packaging company with a comprehensive product portfolio and integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities. It competes with global IDM and fabless companies in NAND Flash and DRAM markets. The company has secured supply relationships with major global storage wafer manufacturers and has penetrated top-tier customers in smartphones, PCs, AI devices, and automotive sectors, enhancing its competitive standing in the Chinese and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Biwin achieved revenue of approximately RMB 6.7 billion, representing an 86.46% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 161 million, a 125.82% increase from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.96 billion, growing 25.72% year-over-year. R&D expenses increased by 78.99% to RMB 447 million, reflecting strong investment in innovation. The company has demonstrated a robust growth trajectory with expanding market share and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Biwin emphasizes its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities combining advanced storage solutions, proprietary controller chip design, and wafer-level advanced packaging technologies. Its products offer high performance, low power consumption, small form factor, and high reliability tailored for AI-driven applications such as AI smartphones, AI PCs, smart wearables, and automotive electronics. The company’s vertical integration and comprehensive service model provide differentiated value by shortening development cycles, enabling customized solutions, and delivering enhanced product quality and innovation.
